c: Open the record the talk is about: the catalog task for the work, the item or the request. A discussion belongs to one record.
say: Open the record the conversation is about: the catalog task for the work, the requested item, or the whole request. Each discussion belongs to one record.

c: In the side panel open Collaborate, choose + and Start Sidebar discussion.
say: In the side panel, open collaborate, choose plus, then start sidebar discussion.

c: On a request you get suggestions: Opened by, Requested for, Assigned to. On items and tasks, search for people yourself.
say: On a request, the dialog suggests who opened it, who it is for, and its assignee. On items and tasks there are no suggestions, so search for the people yourself.

c: Check the Subject, write a short message and choose Start discussion.
say: Check the subject, write a short message, and start the discussion.

c: When the discussion settles something, write it in the Work notes.
say: When the discussion settles something, write the outcome in the work notes, where the next team will look.

c: The person the order is for can be added, but gets no email about it on pdi2. Tell them in Additional comments.
say: You can add the person the order is for, but on pdi2 they get no email about the discussion. Tell them in the additional comments.
